items.title: AI Text Watermarking May Not Be Able to Meet the EU’s New Rules
items.summary: The European Union now requires AI-generated text to be watermarked so that it can be identified as such. But tests on OpenAI’s new textGrain watermark, released in October and developed to comply with the new EU law, show that these watermarks often do not survive additional editing of the text or when it’s under 150 words.
